snippet.title: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Gundam vs Gundam NEXT PLUS — [ PSP ] — Intro & Gameplay
snippet.description:
Continuing on the proud tradition of Intro & Gameplay, I present to you;

Kidou Senshi Gundam: Gundam vs Gundam NEXT PLUS

Here we are. The pinnacle almost of the Gundam vs Gundam series games, and a series I am starting to dislike for it's favoritism towards arcade action. Still, it's a fun game I cannot deny that and you have a wide variety of Mobile Suits even though I think there's a lot lacking. Like you are not allowed to play ANY mobile armor in this game. That's hugely disappointed.

It features all the most popular songs throughout the Gundam series as you'd come to expect by now. The Intro song is Ai Senshi as performed by the famous Gackt. My main disappointment with this game is that it's pilot locked, so no picking what pilot you'd actually want or make your own, no. You're forced to stick with series standards. I'm sorry, but Hayato f-ing sucks as the Guntank's pilot.

If you love these kinds of games, I fully recommend this!

Remember to leave a Like and a Comment.
